name: TOTP Recovery Code Sign-In
summary: Completes a password-issued TOTP MFA challenge with one recovery code, invalidates the lost authenticator enrollment, and adapts the accepted recovery proof to browser-session or mobile-token completion.

sourceReferences.note: AuthenticateWithRecoveryCodeAsync and AuthenticateWithRecoveryCodeTokenAsync adapt accepted recovery proof to the shared proven-user browser or token session completion paths.
Typed handler requires the password-issued MFA challenge, invokes the real recovery-code primitive as step-up, and consumes the challenge after accepted proof.
ConsumeRecoveryCodeAsync consumes one issued code, replaces the remaining-code secret, invalidates the current authenticator, and disables TOTP until re-enrollment.
